candidates.source_name: Národní rozvojová banka (NRB) — Výroční zprávy / "Veškeré informace o hospodaření naší banky"
candidates.why_relevant: Primary, uninterrupted annual-report archive (observed listing spanning 2002-2025) of the Czech national promotional bank. Reports disclose guarantee and loan programme volumes, number of approved cases, programme names (Expanze, Záruka, ENERG, Nová energetická úspora), partner commercial banks acting as on-lending intermediaries, subsidiary structure (NRB Investiční, and post-2024/2025 Česká exportní banka as subsidiary), and audited financials. Because NRB channels support through partner banks, its reports name commercial-bank counterparties, which is exactly the co-financier mapping this cell must deliver.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scheduled crawl of the listing page (~end of April each year); harvest linked PDF annual reports; parse programme volume tables and partner-bank lists; keep a stable year->PDF map since older years use /ke-stazeni/vyrocni-zprava-za-rok-YYYY/ slugs and newer ones use /wp-content/uploads/ PDFs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query -> search result PDF -> fetched nrb.cz homepage nav -> fetched povinně uveřejňované informace -> fetched hospodaření sub-page
queries_used: Národní rozvojová banka výroční zpráva programy podpory

The accompanying budget-committee records and explanatory memoranda often contain forward-looking programme sizing and government intentions before any press release. A full-text search endpoint exists at fulltext.psp.cz.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly full-text search on fulltext.psp.cz for 'pojišťování vývozu se státní podporou', 'Česká exportní banka', 'EGAP', 'Národní rozvojová banka', 'Garanční systém finančního trhu', 'Česká národní banka hospodaření'; capture the tisk number, the /sqw/text/tiskt.sqw document and the /sqw/historie.sqw progress record. Note the electoral-period parameter (o=) changes each term, so search rather than enumerate.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on statutory reporting to Parliament, snowballed from EGAP's own statement of its reporting duty
queries_used: psp.cz sněmovní tisk "Informace o pojišťování vývozu se státní podporou" EGAP zpráva Poslanecké sněmovně
Ministerstvo financí zpráva o pojišťování vývozu se státní podporou sněmovní tisk
local_language_terms_used: informace o pojišťování vývozu se státní podporou

candidates.source_name: Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad (NKÚ) — kontrolní závěry a tiskové zprávy
candidates.why_relevant: The Supreme Audit Office audits exactly the entities in this cell and publishes full audit conclusions as PDFs plus press releases. Confirmed historical coverage includes an audit of state ownership stakes in commercial companies (K15005), a 2011-era audit of ČEB and EGAP that found imprudent lending and breaches of the Banking Act across nine loans worth CZK 13.2bn, and a more recent audit finding the CNB manages its finances without material errors. NKÚ conclusions are the only public source that contradicts the institutions' own self-reporting, which makes them disproportionately valuable for credibility triangulation. NKÚ's audit mandate over export-support institutions is itself anchored in Act 58/1995 Sb. / Act 166/1993 Sb.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of the kontrolní závěry index and the press-release feed, filtered on the in-cell entity names; audit conclusions have stable /assets/kon-zavery/Kxxxxx.pdf paths so back-fill by enumerating the index. Also track the annual audit plan (plán kontrolní činnosti), which pre-announces which institutions will be audited next year.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on the auditor category (category inference: who audits these institutions)
queries_used: Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad kontrolní závěr Česká exportní banka EGAP Národní rozvojová banka
local_language_terms_used: majetkové účasti státu v obchodních společnostech

candidates.source_name: MPO — Finanční nástroje / Majetkové účasti státu (ministry co-owner and programme sponsor)
candidates.why_relevant: The Ministry of Industry and Trade is the programme sponsor behind most NRB financial instruments (Expanze - úvěry / záruky, Úspory energie, ENERG, Nová energetická úspora funded from OPTAK and the Modernisation Fund) and also maintains its own register of state ownership stakes where it exercises shareholder rights. It publishes programme calls, allocation sizes and the government decisions behind restructurings — the MPO press release announcing the government decision to integrate ČEB into NRB is a case in point. Serves as a pointer to programme documentation that NRB itself only summarises.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the financial-instruments section, the majetkové účasti overview and the MPO press-release feed; cross-link every programme name found here to the corresponding NRB product page and annual-report line item.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from NRB search results + cs ownership query
queries_used: Národní rozvojová banka výroční zpráva programy podpory
Ministerstvo financí majetkové účasti státu seznam obchodních společností mfcr

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — tiskové zprávy (press releases, cs) as the ownership-decision channel
candidates.why_relevant: MF exercises shareholder rights over EGAP and (via the ownership chain) the ČEB/NRB group, so its press feed is where ownership restructurings, capital injections, board appointments and legislative milestones surface first — observed items include the government decision to integrate ČEB and NRB, three separate stages of the Act on the National Development Bank passing through the Chamber of Deputies, and annual announcements on results of strategic state companies and compliance with remuneration principles.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the year-indexed press-release listing; mfcr.cz and mf.gov.cz serve the same content and mfcr.cz paths 308-redirect, so normalise hosts before deduplicating.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on ministry reporting -> mfcr.cz press index

negative_findings.description: Two plausible-looking disclosure URLs returned HTTP 404 on first fetch: https://www.nrb.cz/o-nas/povinne-zverejnovane-informace/ and https://ceb.cz/informace/povinne-zverejnovane-informace1/vz-html (the latter appeared as a search-result title). Both were constructed or copied rather than confirmed from live navigation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Correct live paths were then recovered from each site's own navigation: NRB uses 'povinně UVEŘEJŇOVANÉ informace' (https://www.nrb.cz/o-nas/povinne-uverejnovane-informace/) while ČEB uses 'povinně ZVEŘEJŇOVANÉ informace' (https://www.ceb.cz/informace/povinne-zverejnovane-informace/) with annual reports at /o-bance/vyrocni-zpravy/. Neither 404 is evidence the sites or sections are dead — both are alive under different slugs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Czech institutions use two near-identical statutory phrases (uveřejňované vs. zveřejňované) for the same disclosure duty. A collector that hard-codes one variant will silently miss entities using the other, and a liveness checker will record false deaths.

negative_findings.description: Searched for English-language annual reports of Česká exportní banka. The ČEB annual-report index lists Czech-only PDFs for every year 2012-2025 (filenames end in -cs.pdf or are Czech-titled consolidated auditor reports); no English annual report was listed on that page.
negative_findings.result_summary: An English site section exists at ceb.cz/en/, but no English annual report file was identified for any year.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream comparison of Czech state export finance against peer ECAs or export banks will need Czech-language parsing or machine translation for ČEB; budgeting for that now avoids a silent coverage hole.

negative_findings.description: No English-language version of Garanční systém finančního trhu materials (annual reports, budgets, bond prospectuses) was identified. All documents observed on garancnisystem.cz/dokumenty are Czech-titled.
negative_findings.result_summary: GSFT deposit-insurance and resolution-fund reporting appears to be Czech-only in the material found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deposit-insurance fund size and resolution-fund build-up are core comparative metrics across EU markets; Czech-only publication means cross-country benchmarking of the Czech safety net requires local-language extraction.

negative_findings.description: Looked for machine-readable feeds (RSS/Atom, JSON, open-data endpoints) published by the in-cell institutions themselves — NRB, ČEB, EGAP, GSFT. None were identified during this pass; all content is HTML index pages plus PDFs.
negative_findings.result_summary: No first-party API or feed found for any of the four core state financial institutions. EGAP additionally uses tokenised one-time-looking download URLs (/cs/file/<id>/download?token=...).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be scrape-based with change detection rather than feed-based, and EGAP download links cannot be cached across runs. The only genuinely machine-readable routes in this cell are third-party or cross-cutting (Hlídač státu API, MONITOR státní pokladna open data, Registr smluv dumps).

negative_findings.description: Searched in Czech for EGAP interim/quarterly statistics on insured export volumes ('čtvrtletní data', 'statistiky pojištěného vývozu') as a higher-frequency alternative to the annual report.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated quarterly statistics page or dataset was located on egap.cz. The recurring public figures (insured volume, profit, number of policies, destination countries, Fond Ukrajina volumes) appear to be released annually via press release and then re-syndicated by ČTK-fed outlets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Intra-year visibility on Czech state-backed export capacity is limited to press releases and to the semi-annual reporting EGAP makes to the Chamber of Deputies; the parliamentary route (psp.cz) may therefore be the only sub-annual quantitative channel and should be prioritised.

negative_findings.description: For Garanční fond obchodníků s cennými papíry (gfo.cz), search results surfaced the homepage and third-party restatements of the fund's rules and older annual reports (2004, 2007, 2016 referenced) but no annual-report index page on gfo.cz was directly confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Entity and its statutory role are confirmed; the location and completeness of its own annual-report archive are not. This is unverified, not absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: GFO completes the Czech financial safety-net map alongside GSFT; if its own publication is thin, or.justice.cz filings and CNB records become the fallback route and that needs to be decided before the collection run.

negative_findings.description: Ministry of Finance content is served from two hostnames: legacy mfcr.cz and current mf.gov.cz. A fetch of https://www.mfcr.cz/cs/verejny-sektor/majetek-statu/majetkove-ucasti returned HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect to https://mf.gov.cz/cs/verejny-sektor/majetek-statu/majetkove-ucasti. Both hostnames also appear in live search results with different path prefixes (/cs/kontrola-a-regulace/... vs /cs/verejny-sektor/...).
negative_findings.result_summary: Same content, two hosts and at least two path taxonomies. Not a failure, but a deduplication and link-rot hazard.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without host and path normalisation, the MF ownership register and financial-market reports will be double-counted or lost when legacy redirects are eventually retired.

negative_findings.description: Multiple independent Czech sources (MPO and MF press releases, NKÚ-related coverage) indicate the government decided to integrate Česká exportní banka into Národní rozvojová banka, with ČEB becoming a subsidiary of NRB, supported by a dedicated Act on the National Development Bank passing the Chamber of Deputies in 2024.
negative_findings.result_summary: This is a live restructuring affecting two of the cell's core entities, not a stable steady state. Reporting perimeter, consolidation basis and possibly the publishing domain (ceb.cz) are at risk of change.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Time series built on standalone ČEB reporting may break; consolidated NRB group reporting may absorb ČEB figures. The source map must record entity lineage (ČMZRB -> NRB; ČEB -> NRB subsidiary) or year-on-year comparisons will be silently wrong.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's entities have changed names and legal perimeters: Českomoravská záruční a rozvojová banka (ČMZRB) -> Národní rozvojová banka (NRB); Fond pojištění vkladů -> Garanční systém finančního trhu (GSFT, from 1.1.2016 under Act 374/2015 Sb., now holding both FPV and FŘK); and ČEB is being absorbed as an NRB subsidiary. Procurement platforms still file NRB under the legacy 'CMZRB' authority code.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and store an explicit alias/lineage table keyed by IČO (NRB 44848943, ČNB 48136450, ČEB 63078333, SFPI 70856788, plus EGAP and GSFT identifiers to be captured) covering former names, acronyms, English-in-Czech forms and legacy platform codes, and apply it to every query and dedupe step.

coverage_gaps.description: Contracting-authority profiles were positively located for NRB (TenderArena + NEN + own page) and ČNB (E-ZAK + vhodne-uverejneni.cz), and a procurement page was located for ČEB. No procurement profile was located for EGAP, GSFT, PGRLF or the Kancelář finančního arbitra in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run an IČO-keyed sweep across Věstník veřejných zakázek, NEN, TenderArena, E-ZAK instances, gemin.cz and vhodne-uverejneni.cz for every remaining in-cell entity, and record which platform each authority actually uses. Treat Registr smluv as the backstop, since contract publication is mandatory even where a tender profile is hard to find.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is dominated by annual publications. Apart from MF's monthly ownership snapshots, NRB's Pillar 3 disclosures, GSFT prospectus supplements and the press feeds, there is little sub-annual quantitative disclosure — and no first-party API from any core entity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Anchor sub-annual monitoring on four cross-cutting routes instead: (1) psp.cz full-text for EGAP/ČEB/ČNB parliamentary submissions, (2) Registr smluv new-contract feeds by IČO, (3) NRB CRR 575/2013 quarterly/semi-annual disclosures, (4) GSFT bond-programme prospectuses and supplements, which restate fund balances for investors between annual reports.

coverage_gaps.description: GSFT annual reports and budgets give fund positions in PDF form, but no structured time series of Fond pojištění vkladů / Fond pro řešení krize balances, contribution rates or covered-deposit base was identified — for example in the CNB ARAD statistical database or an EU-level dataset (EBA deposit-guarantee data, EFDI).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe CNB ARAD for a deposit-insurance or covered-deposits series, and check EBA's published DGS funds-available data and EFDI membership pages for a machine-readable Czech series that can be joined to the GSFT PDFs.

coverage_gaps.description: NRB operates as a national promotional bank alongside EIF/EIB, InvestEU and Modernisation Fund instruments, and appears in at least one European Commission transport-facility programme fiche; EGAP operates within the OECD Arrangement on Officially Supported Export Credits and Berne Union reporting. None of these supranational counterpart sources were worked in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep of EIF/EIB counterpart announcements and InvestEU implementing-partner disclosures naming NRB, plus OECD export-credit and Berne Union statistics naming Czechia, as an indirect route that quantifies programme volumes independently of the Czech institutions' own reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech terminology was established for annual reporting, disclosure, procurement, guarantees and deposit insurance. It was NOT established for the internal operating/vendor vocabulary these institutions use in tenders — e.g. core banking, card issuing/acquiring, ATM and self-service estate, payment terminal servicing, document management — which is the vocabulary a procurement-focused sweep actually needs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Before the collection run, mine 20-30 actual tender titles from the NRB TenderArena/NEN profiles and ČNB E-ZAK to extract real Czech procurement phrasing and CPV codes, then feed those verbatim terms back into search rather than translating English vendor terminology into Czech.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage focused on national-level institutions. Regional development funds, the Czech-Moravian Guarantee scheme's regional arms, Národní rozvojový fond, and municipal/regional co-financing vehicles that partner with commercial banks were not surveyed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from the NRB 'Naši partneři / přehled institucí' page and from the MF and MPO ownership registers to enumerate second-tier public financial vehicles, then triage them by whether they publish an annual report and whether they name partner banks.

brief: The Czech public-sector financial landscape in this cell is unusually well documented but almost entirely PDF-based and Czech-first: NRB, ČEB, EGAP, GSFT, the CNB, the Financial Arbiter and MF all maintain deep, stable annual-report archives (EGAP 2003-2025, GSFT 2005-2025 on predictable paths, ČEB 2012-2025, NRB 2002-2025, CNB with a genuine English mirror), and MF adds a near-monthly state-ownership register that makes the ownership chain over EGAP and the ČEB/NRB group traceable in near-real time. Because these bodies publish on a public-accountability rather than investor basis, three routes exist that commercial-bank cells do not have: statutory reporting to the Chamber of Deputies (EGAP and CNB submissions, findable via fulltext.psp.cz), independent NKÚ audit conclusions that have historically contradicted the institutions' own accounts, and full procurement exposure through E-ZAK/NEN/TenderArena plus the Registr smluv, which names IT and services suppliers and contract values outright. The main risks to a collection plan are structural rather than technical: ČEB is being absorbed into NRB under the 2024 National Development Bank Act, so reporting perimeters and time series will break; the same statutory duty appears under two near-identical Czech slugs (povinně uveřejňované vs. zveřejňované), and MF content straddles mfcr.cz and mf.gov.cz. No first-party API exists for any core entity, so machine-readable collection must lean on Hlídač státu, MONITOR státní pokladna and the Registr smluv, with EGAP's tokenised download links re-scraped rather than cached.
